topic: Megumi lost the body fight because the Ten Shadows answer to whoever owns the body, and by the end that was Sukuna
title: Why Megumi Was Always Going to Lose Sukuna's Shikigami Trap
description:
Megumi summoned Mahoraga in Shibuya and still ended up as the one being saved, not the one winning. This breakdown follows the Shibuya fight, the Culling Game takeover and the Ten Shadows rules to show why the outcome was sealed by control of the body, not raw power.

1:20 Sukuna needed him alive
3:10 A body with two owners
5:40 What the shikigami really are
8:00 The strongest counter-argument
10:10 The verdict
12:30 The last word

Did Megumi ever have a real chance, or was the outcome decided the moment Sukuna got inside him? Tell me which side you land on.
comment: Did Megumi lose because Sukuna was simply stronger, or because whoever owns the body always controls the Ten Shadows?
